sn36.6:1.1: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano sukhampi vedanaṃ vedayati dukkhampi vedanaṃ vedayati adukkhamasukhampi vedanaṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:1.2: sutavā bhikkhave ariyasāvako sukhampi vedanaṃ vedayati dukkhampi vedanaṃ vedayati adukkhamasukhampi vedanaṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:1.3: tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
sn36.6:1.5: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
sn36.6:1.9: tamenaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ vijjheyyuṃ evaṃ
sn36.6:1.10: hi so bhikkhave puriso dve sallena vedanā vedayati kāyikañca cetasikañca.
sn36.6:1.11: evameva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
sn36.6:1.14: tassā yeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavā hoti
sn36.6:1.15: tamenaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo so anuseti
sn36.6:1.16: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukhaṃ abhinandati.
sn36.6:1.18: na hi bhikkhave pajānāti. assutavā puthujjano aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ
sn36.6:1.19: tassa kāmasukhaṃ ca abhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so anuseti
sn36.6:1.20: so tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn36.6:1.21: tassa tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so anuseti
sn36.6:1.22: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati saññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.6:1.23: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati saññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.6:1.24: adukkhamasukhañca vedanaṃ vedayati saññutto naṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:1.25: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano saññutto jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi saññutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn36.6:2.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati
sn36.6:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave purisaṃ sallena vijjheyyuṃ na
sn36.6:3.2: tamenaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ vijjheyyuṃ. evaṃ
sn36.6:3.3: hi so bhikkhave puriso ekasallena vedanaṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati
sn36.6:3.7: tassāyeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavā na hoti
sn36.6:3.8: tamenaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo so nānuseti
sn36.6:3.9: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukhaṃ nābhinandati.
sn36.6:3.11: pajānāti so bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ.
sn36.6:3.12: tassa kāmasukhaṃ nābhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so nānuseti
sn36.6:3.13: so tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn36.6:3.14: tassa tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānato yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so nānuseti
sn36.6:3.15: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.6:3.16: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.6:3.17: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:3.18: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako visaññutto jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi visaññutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn36.6:3.19: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyaso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
